'''Drazaal Row''' was a street in the [[Duros Sector]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] maintained an [[Intelligence Post Drazaal|outpost]] along the street that monitored the sector.<ref name="TOR" />

The merchant [[Bellym Karr]] worked in Drazaal Row during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:TLoN">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Library of Nul|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Drazaal Row appears as part of the Duros Sector in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
